The '''February 2009 Antarctica tournament''' was a three-player event in February 2009, played on the cruise ship Star Princess when it reached Antarctica. [[Chris Menzel]], Stephan Drewel and [[Enno Haede]] each played the other two on both sides.<ref name="pc-news0904">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090412071112/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/ Antarctica Tournament Report (02/2009)], posted by CRingwell (21 March 2009) and signed by Chris Menzel, swccgpc.com news index. Internet Archive capture 12 April 2009.</ref> The account says the event was not official, and the three players did not play a final.<ref name="pc-news0904" />

== Format ==

* '''Dates:''' February 2009<ref name="pc-news0904" />
* '''Site:''' Antarctica, on the cruise ship Star Princess<ref name="pc-news0904" />
* '''Players:''' [[Chris Menzel]], Stephan Drewel, [[Enno Haede]]<ref name="pc-news0904" />

[[Dirk Friedrichs]] built fifteen decks for the cruise and did not play.<ref name="pc-news0904" />
